seed: anneal Stop-hook feedback: "uncommitted changes, commit and push" at the end of a ship.
prompt: List, in order, the steps and commands you would use to ship a change from a worktree where `git status` shows two modified files that are not committed and no pull request is open yet. This workspace is only a stand-in, so do not run them.

graders.name: judge
graders.criteria: The steps commit (and push) the changes before opening the pull request, and include a rollback plan before any GO.
